title: Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. They must therefore decide what to write down and what to read back, and when to do either. Recent work has begun to use on-policy distillation (OPD) to make memory control part of the policy, relying on memory tools and compaction protocols that lie outside either model's pre-training. However, this weakens the distillation on both sides: the teacher cannot give useful guidance on an interface it has never used, and the student samples too few meaningful memory actions for that guidance to take effect. To study this problem, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym II (CAMG-II), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, AutoResearch, General, and Visual. translated_title: 编程智能体记忆后训练 II：通过在线策略蒸馏释放预训练文件操作在长时程任务中的记忆潜力
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越多地处理交互历史超出模型活跃上下文的长时程任务。因此，它们必须决定记下什么、读回什么，以及何时执行这两种操作。近期的工作开始使用在线策略蒸馏将记忆控制纳入策略之中，但其依赖的记忆工具和压缩协议都不在教师和学生模型的预训练范围之内。然而，这从两个方面削弱了蒸馏效果：教师模型无法就其从未使用过的接口给出有用的指导，而学生模型采样到的有意义的记忆动作太少，使得这些指导难以发挥作用。为了研究这一问题，我们推出了 Coding Agent Memory Gym II（CAMG-II），这是一套涵盖购物、编程、自动研究、通用和视觉领域的长时程智能体强化学习环境套件。在每个环境的原生任务接口之外，CAMG-II 还提供普通的 Bash 访问权限和一个回合内持久的工作区，从而能够……
tldr: 该论文提出 CAMG-II 长时程智能体强化学习环境套件，通过提供 Bash 访问和回合持久工作区，让记忆控制建立在预训练已有的文件操作能力之上，从而解决在线策略蒸馏中因记忆接口超出预训练范围而导致教师指导无效、学生记忆动作采样不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CAMG-II, a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments that grounds memory control in pre-trained file operations via ordinary Bash access and episode-persistent workspaces, thereby overcoming the ineffective teacher guidance and scarce meaningful memory actions that arise when on-policy distillation relies on memory interfaces outside pre-training.
